newsitem.title: UK: BASF SEES NO ADVANTAGE IN GAZPROM STAKE.
newsitem.headline: BASF SEES NO ADVANTAGE IN GAZPROM STAKE.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF said on Thursday it saw no advantage in taking a stake in the Russian gas company Gazprom.
Juergen Strube, chairman of BASF, told a news conference here, that "having a minority stake would not enhance our relationship."
BASF have invested five billion marks in a joint venture with Gazprom, principally in constructing pipelines.
"We have discussed the idea of taking a stake in Gazprom with our partner and the conclusion is that our partnership does not require us (to do this)," Strube said.

Executives also told the press conference that they expected gas sales in the German market to increase by 20 percent this year and that a market share of 15 percent should be reached by the year 2000.
